anchors.description: Front-face diagonal of the black LCD monitor/TV standing on the desk, from the top-left screen corner to the bottom-right screen corner.
anchors.visible_evidence: Rectangular black panel with thin bezel, webcam block on top, sitting on the raised desk shelf; both endpoints lie on the front face corners of the panel.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Exact viewable diagonal class (17-22 in) is unknown; bezel-vs-panel corner placement and a slightly oblique viewing angle add a few percent error.

anchors.description: Diameter across the five-star caster base of the grey task chair, measured between the left and right outer ends of the base visible on the carpet.
anchors.visible_evidence: Grey upholstered task chair on castors; the dark star base spreads from the left arm tip to the right arm tip across the carpet, both endpoints on the base.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Typical 5-star office chair bases range about 55-70 cm; the two chosen tips may not be exactly diametrically opposite, so the chord can underestimate the true diameter.

anchors.description: Length along the bed's top surface from the head end next to the pillow to the foot end at the comforter edge by the footboard.
anchors.visible_evidence: Made bed with striped comforter, pillow at the head and metal footboard at the foot; the line follows the mattress top from head to foot.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: All US standard adult mattresses (twin/full/queen) are 203 cm long, but the endpoints sit slightly inside the mattress edges (pillow centre, comforter edge), so the chord is a little shorter; the bed size itself is not identifiable.

anchors.description: Length of one black shoe lying on the carpet near the shelving unit, from heel to toe.
anchors.visible_evidence: Two low black shoes side by side on the carpet in front of the baseboard; heel and toe of the nearer shoe are both visible.
anchors.identity_uncertainty: Shoe type/size is not identifiable (could be loafers, dress shoes or slippers); small objects make endpoint placement relatively imprecise.
